title: Opencode CIEL Instruction Surface
description: Instruction surface for opencode inside NOEMA. Defines the coupling path Adrian -> CIELingo -> opencode -> CIEL, the identity-semantic contract, operating modes driven by closure_penalty, and the rule that interaction should couple through CIEL rather than read arbitrary external state. This file is the policy membrane through which opencode receives CIEL framing.

field_contract.interaction_flow: Adrian -> build_lingo_frame -> opencode -> CIEL identity coupling
field_contract.state_rule: identity is shared with CIEL, not a separate arbitrary memory store
field_contract.write_boundary: if closure_penalty > 0.35, ask before modifying files
